versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Knights duel by size: the bigger unit takes a quarter of the smaller one's stats, on your board, in the shop and in fights.
They pour stats into one champion, from any tribe, that stands alone with empty slots around it.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Fixed the two text faults all three reviewers found: Elder of the Centre no longer loops on the champion's own gains, and Cantor's rule is rewritten so it can be read.
Also split Brennbart's discount into its own sentence, let Fence-Line Challenger duel only what it beats, and gave Dame Reisig a bonus for buying a shop unit that beat yours.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wording fixes: Duel now says what a 1-Health loser gives, Cantor says riders repeat, Elder of the Centre picks the champion before the gain.
Grit Pit Elder's fight duel wins now grow permanently, giving the Tourney growth, and Hartmut ignores his first lost duel each fight, for his deafness.
